sequence.lotm.warrior.9.intro: The first digestion. The body is tougher and weapons sit more naturally in the hand. No spectacle yet, only heavier, steadier swings. Stats: +4 health, +1 attack, +1 armor, a little speed, +20 mana.
sequence.lotm.warrior.8.intro: Close combat becomes instinct. At arm's length you start to pin the opponent. Stats: +2 health, +1 attack, +0.2 attack speed, +0.15 knockback resistance.
sequence.lotm.warrior.7.intro: A weapon in hand becomes an extension of the body. One swing can open a line. Stats: +4 health, +2 attack, +1 armor toughness, +0.1 attack speed.
sequence.lotm.warrior.6.intro: Dawn Paladin. This rank grants 5 active and 1 passive skills, including Dawn Aura, Dawn Charge, Dawn Slash, Dawn Armor, Sword of Dawn, Storm of Light. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.lotm.warrior.5.intro: Guardian. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.lotm.warrior.4.intro: Demon Hunter. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.lotm.warrior.3.intro: Silver Knight. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.lotm.warrior.2.intro: Glory. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.lotm.warrior.1.intro: Hand of God. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.lotm.warrior.0.intro: Twilight Giant. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.lotm.warrior.old_one.intro: Old One. This is not another potion. It is a rank above sequence 0 and grants no extra skills.
sequence.lotm.warrior.pillar.intro: Pillar. This is the end of the ladder above Old One. It grants no extra skills.
sequence.lotm.painter.9.intro: The low sequence of the High-Dimensional Overlooker. Pigment starts remembering your spirit, and a plain mark can trip whoever steps on it. Stats: +1 luck (spiritual intuition).
sequence.lotm.painter.8.intro: What you see becomes a record. Invisibility and hidden forms do not hold, and you outrun the news. Kills sometimes leave extra experience or a rare note.
sequence.lotm.mother.9.intro: Seeds understand the hurry. Soil underfoot sends a little life back. Stats: +2 health.
sequence.lotm.mother.8.intro: Wounds and potions listen. A hand can close a cut and wipe one curse, and what you drink lingers. +10% healing received, +20% potion duration.
spell.lotm.warrior_slash.guide: A short cone slash. Damage scales with attack. 4s cooldown.
spell.lotm.pugilist_combo.guide: Two close strikes and a knockback. 6s cooldown.
spell.lotm.weapon_break.guide: A wide arc that slows what it hits. 8s cooldown.
spell.lotm.spiritual_graffiti.guide: Place a graffiti trap at the crosshair for 25s. Enemies who step on it are slowed for 4s and glow. 15 mana, 20s cooldown.
spell.lotm.true_sight.guide: For 15s, see through invisibility and forms hidden from you. 20 mana, 25s cooldown.
spell.lotm.natural_growth.guide: Mature crops in a 3x3 at the crosshair or your feet, and restore 4 health. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.
spell.lotm.healing_hands.guide: Heal the creature within 5 blocks of the crosshair, or yourself. Restore 8 health and remove one harmful effect. 25 mana, 15s cooldown.
passive.lotm.battle_instinct.desc: On hit taken: brief speed and resistance, plus a small heal. 8s cooldown.
passive.lotm.close_pressure.desc: On attack: briefly slow the target. 5s cooldown.
passive.lotm.read_the_blow.desc: On hit taken: reduce that hit by 30% and gain brief absorption. 12s cooldown.
passive.lotm.color_sense.desc: +1 luck. Spawners, trial spawners, and infested blocks within 16 blocks are outlined, and the nearest is called out.
passive.lotm.recorder.desc: On kill: 45% extra experience, 18% a rare drop.
passive.lotm.earth_power.desc: +2 health. While standing on dirt, grass, or farmland, restore 0.5 health per second.
sequence.lotm.red_priest.9.intro: A trap is quieter than a bow. Stats: +2 attack. Active: Place Trap. Passive: Hunter's Eye, +10% damage to animals and monsters.
sequence.lotm.red_priest.8.intro: Anger can be pulled onto you. Active: Taunt. Passive: Combat Instinct.
sequence.lotm.hanged_man.9.intro: A hidden supplicant can take another's blessing and notice concealed steps. Active: Steal Touch. Passive: Hidden Perception.
sequence.lotm.hanged_man.8.intro: A whisper scrambles the target's footing. Stats: +1 luck. Active: Mad Whisper. Passive: Spiritual Intuition.
spell.lotm.tracking_arrow.guide: Fire a homing arrow. On hit, bleed for 1 damage per second for 5 seconds. 15 mana, 8s cooldown.
spell.lotm.taunt_roar.guide: Force hostile mobs within 8 blocks to attack you and reduce their armor by 4 for 4 seconds. 20 mana, 12s cooldown.
spell.lotm.steal_touch.guide: Cast at a creature, or right-click one, to steal a random beneficial effect. Works on players. Sneak-right-click villagers, horses, and pets. 25 mana, 15s cooldown.
spell.lotm.mad_whisper.guide: Confuse and weaken the looked-at target for 5 seconds. Confusion randomizes movement. 30 mana, 20s cooldown.
passive.lotm.beast_instinct.desc: +2 attack, +0.05 movement speed. When hit, enemies within 16 blocks and the attacker briefly glow. 4s cooldown.
passive.lotm.battle_frenzy.desc: Below 50% health: +10% attack speed and +10% damage.
passive.lotm.hidden_perception.desc: +10% experience. Continuously sense invisible entities within 16 blocks. Only you can see them.
passive.lotm.spiritual_intuition.desc: +1 luck. 10% chance to ignore an incoming hit.
sequence.lotm.spectator.9.intro: The start of the Visionary pathway. Other people's intent starts to show. Stats: +2 luck. Active: Subtle Guidance. Passive: Keen Observation.
sequence.lotm.spectator.8.intro: Thoughts are no longer only faces. Stats: +5% spell damage. Actives: Mind Reading, and the second active Mind Mimic. Passive: Mind Intuition. This slice has no digestion meter, so Mind Mimic unlocks with sequence 8.
sequence.lotm.sun.9.intro: The song carries courage outward. Stats: +10 health. Active: Hymn. Passive: Courage Resonance.
sequence.lotm.sun.8.intro: Clean light starts to punish filth. Stats: +2 armor. Actives: Purifying Light, and the second active Exorcism. Passive: Holy Affinity. Undead damage stacks with sequence 9 for +20% total. Exorcism unlocks with sequence 8.
spell.lotm.subtle_guidance.guide: Cast at a creature. A hostile target randomly switches its attack to nearby creatures for 6s. A neutral or friendly one follows you for 20s. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.
spell.lotm.subtle_guidance.hostile: Subtle guidance: the target turns on nearby creatures
spell.lotm.subtle_guidance.follow: Subtle guidance: the target starts following you
spell.lotm.mind_read.guide: Read the looked-at creature's current intent into chat. On a player, show the held item and main beneficial effects. 10 mana, 5s cooldown.
spell.lotm.mind_mimic.guide: Sequence 8's second active. For 6s the target stands with you: it stops attacking you and attacks nearby monsters instead. 30 mana, 40s cooldown.
spell.lotm.mind_mimic.applied: Mind mimic: the target briefly stands with you
spell.lotm.hymn.guide: Allies within 8 blocks gain Strength I and Speed I for 20s, and lose slowness, mining fatigue, and similar discomfort. 25 mana, 30s cooldown.
spell.lotm.purifying_light.guide: Drop a light pillar at the crosshair. Undead take full holy damage and a short burn; other creatures take half. 20 mana, 10s cooldown.
spell.lotm.exorcism.guide: Sequence 8's second active. Cleanse a friendly under the crosshair who has harmful effects, or yourself. Remove all harmful effects and grant Resistance I for 8s. 25 mana, 20s cooldown.
spell.lotm.need_mob: Look at a creature with behavior
passive.lotm.keen_observation.desc: +2 luck. Kills grant 10% extra experience. Particles above nearby creatures show health: green high, yellow mid, red low.
passive.lotm.mind_intuition.desc: +5% spell damage. When hit, 8% chance to weaken the attacker for 3s.
passive.lotm.courage_resonance.desc: +10 health. In sunlight, restore 1 health every 5s. +5% damage to undead.
passive.lotm.holy_affinity.desc: +2 armor. +15% more damage to undead (stacks with Courage Resonance for +20%). Immune to the Wither effect.
sequence.lotm.fate_circle.9.intro: The senses sink into the soil. Ore, plants, and living things light up, and the arm reaches farther. Stats: +2 melee reach, +1 luck. Active: Resource Sense. Passive: Seven Senses.
sequence.lotm.fate_circle.8.intro: You start choosing instead of scavenging. The next strike brings the block itself, and danger makes the feet move first. Active: Precise Harvest. Passive: Danger Premonition.
sequence.lotm.primordial_hunger.9.intro: The street wears the body into something that can keep living. Desert and the Nether no longer empty the stomach. Stats: +2 armor. Active: Street Brawl. Passive: Environmental Adaptation.
sequence.lotm.primordial_hunger.8.intro: Hunger stops being a flaw and becomes an appetite. Food goes down at once, and poison no longer sticks. Stats: +2 max health. Active: Devour. Passive: Toxin Resistance.
spell.lotm.resource_sense.guide: Highlight ores, crops, flowers, and creatures within 12 blocks for 20 seconds. Leaves are not highlighted. 10 mana, 25s cooldown.
spell.lotm.precise_harvest.guide: The next dig drops the block itself, with a 35% chance of one extra. Lasts 10 minutes or until you dig. 15 mana, 30s cooldown.
spell.lotm.precise_harvest.ready: The next dig will harvest precisely
spell.lotm.street_brawl.guide: A quick strike ahead. Extra damage and a slow. 10 mana, 6s cooldown.
spell.lotm.devour.guide: Right-click food, or cast while holding food, to eat it instantly and gain 2 extra hunger. 5 mana, 5s cooldown.
passive.lotm.environment_adapt.desc: Desert and the Nether do not drain hunger. +2 armor.
passive.lotm.toxin_resist.desc: Immune to Poison and Hunger. +2 max health.
sequence.lotm.thief.9.intro: The start of the Error pathway. The hand is faster than the eye. Stats: +10% attack speed, +0.05 movement speed. Active: Thief's Touch. Passive: Agile Hands. The design's +0.5 speed would be six times walking speed, so this uses +0.05 like the other pathways.
sequence.lotm.thief.8.intro: Words start rewriting other people's judgment. Stats: +1 luck. Actives: Mental Interference, and the sequence 8 advanced skill Thought Misdirection. Passive: Eloquence. This slice has no digestion meter, so Thought Misdirection unlocks with sequence 8.
sequence.lotm.apprentice.9.intro: The start of the Door pathway. A wall is no longer absolute. Stats: +5% movement speed. Active: Open Door. Passive: Spirit World Sense.
sequence.lotm.apprentice.8.intro: Flash and noise become technique. Stats: +0.05 movement speed. Actives: Flash, and the sequence 8 advanced skill Loud Noise. Passive: Spatial Intuition. Loud Noise unlocks with sequence 8. Open Door gains +2 range and -20% cooldown.
spell.lotm.thief_touch.guide: Look at a creature within 4.5 blocks. Randomly steal one hotbar item or transfer one beneficial effect. Item theft against players fails 35% of the time and returns an empty bottle. 15 mana, 20s cooldown.
spell.lotm.thief_touch.bottle: The hand slips. Only an empty bottle.
spell.lotm.mind_interference.guide: Blind and scramble movement of the looked-at target within 8 blocks for 4 seconds. Damage clears the scramble. 25 mana, 25s cooldown.
spell.lotm.thought_mislead.guide: Leave a stationary afterimage for 5 seconds. A hit pops it and slows the attacker for 2 seconds. 20 mana, 30s cooldown.
spell.lotm.open_door.guide: Look at a wall and step through it, up to 8 blocks. Iron doors and fence gates do not stop it. Bedrock, barriers, and command blocks do. 15 mana, 12s cooldown.
spell.lotm.open_door.blocked: There is no door to open here
spell.lotm.flash.guide: Blind creatures in a cone ahead for 3 seconds. Undead also take a small hit. 15 mana, 15s cooldown.
spell.lotm.loud_noise.guide: Crack a noise at the crosshair, up to 10 blocks. Hostile creatures within 12 blocks turn toward it for 4 seconds. 20 mana, 25s cooldown.
passive.lotm.agile_hands.desc: +10% attack speed, +0.05 movement speed. Daggers and short swords deal +10% damage. Add weapons to the lotm:short_blades tag.
passive.lotm.eloquence.desc: Villager prices stay discounted as if you held Hero of the Village. +1 luck. +5% kill experience.
passive.lotm.spirit_sense.desc: +5% movement speed. Nether portals, end portals, and ender pearl landing points within 16 blocks are outlined.
passive.lotm.spatial_intuition.desc: Open Door cooldown -20%, range +2. +0.05 movement speed.
sequence.lotm.witch.9.intro: The body starts to fit into shadow. Active: Stealth. Passive: Shadow Affinity.
sequence.lotm.witch.8.intro: One sentence can rewrite who gets hit. Stats: +1 luck. Active: Mental Instigation. Passive: Charm.
sequence.lotm.witch.7.intro: Witch. This rank grants 5 active and 2 passive skills, including Gender Transition, Invisibility, Black Flame, Frost Control, Mirror Divination, Mirror Substitute, and others. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.lotm.witch.6.intro: Pleasure. This rank grants 6 active and 2 passive skills, including Alluring Aura, Mirror Mastery, Spider Silk, Silk Cocoon, Black Flame (Volley), Ice Spear, and others. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.lotm.witch.5.intro: Agony. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.lotm.witch.4.intro: Despair. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.lotm.witch.3.intro: Ageless. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.lotm.witch.2.intro: Catastrophe. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.lotm.witch.1.intro: Apocalypse. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.lotm.witch.0.intro: Witch. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.lotm.witch.old_one.intro: Old One. This is not another potion. It is a rank above sequence 0 and grants no extra skills.
sequence.lotm.witch.pillar.intro: Pillar. This is the end of the ladder above Old One. It grants no extra skills.
spell.lotm.place_trap.guide: Hide a trap on the crosshair for 45 seconds, up to 3. An enemy that steps on it takes 6 damage and is rooted for 3 seconds. Only you see a faint ash mark. 15 mana, 20s cooldown.
spell.lotm.taunt.guide: Force the mob on the crosshair to attack you and reduce its armor by 4 for 5 seconds. Players only lose armor. 15 mana, 15s cooldown.
spell.lotm.stealth.guide: Become invisible for 12 seconds. A melee attack, a projectile, or taking damage breaks it. 20 mana, 20s cooldown.
spell.lotm.instigate.guide: For 5 seconds the mob on the crosshair attacks random nearby creatures. A player target is nauseated instead. 25 mana, 25s cooldown.
passive.lotm.hunters_eye.desc: +2 attack. +10% damage to animals and monsters.
passive.lotm.provoke_reflex.desc: When hit, 35% chance to reflect 40% of the damage to the attacker.
passive.lotm.shadow_affinity.desc: While sneaking, +15% movement speed. Fall damage reduced by 50%.
passive.lotm.charm.desc: Villager prices are about 20% lower. +1 luck.
sequence.lotm.sailor.9.intro: The sea already knows you. Water breathing and night vision can be called up, and water no longer drags your steps. Stats: +10 health. Underwater movement +20%, and mining is not slowed underwater.
sequence.lotm.sailor.8.intro: Rage rises with the wound. The lower your health, the heavier the fan strike; after you are hit, the next blow is heavier. Stats: +1 armor.
sequence.lotm.wizard.9.intro: Secrets start speaking to you. Spirit vision lights hidden traps, ore, and creatures, and spells cost less while hitting harder. Spell cost -5%, spell damage +5%.
sequence.lotm.wizard.8.intro: A fight can be taken apart into steps. Melee hits harder, and a successful block sets up the next blow. Stats: +3 melee attack.
spell.lotm.sea_blessing.guide: Water breathing and night vision for 60 seconds. While it lasts, water does not slow movement. 15 mana, 30s cooldown.
spell.lotm.storm_wrath.guide: Physical damage and knockback in a forward fan. Lower health means higher damage, up to about 2.5x near death. 20 mana, 10s cooldown.
spell.lotm.spirit_vision.guide: For 30 seconds, nearby hidden traps, ore, and creatures glow. Only you can see it. 10 mana, 20s cooldown.
spell.lotm.knowledge_strike.guide: The next melee hit is a critical and ignores 40% of armor reduction. Lasts 30 seconds or until it connects. 15 mana, 15s cooldown.
passive.lotm.ocean_affinity.desc: Underwater movement +20%. Mining speed is not reduced underwater. +10 max health.
passive.lotm.storm_guard.desc: After being hit, the next melee attack deals +20% damage. +1 armor.
passive.lotm.combat_analysis.desc: Melee attack +3. After a successful block, the next melee attack deals +15% damage.
screen.exworld.sequence_skill_empty: Select a skill to read it. Shift-click an active skill to cast it.
screen.exworld.sequence_no_skills: This sequence grants no skills yet
command.exworld.sequence.no_pathways: No pathways registered. Make sure the lotm addon is loaded with ExWorld.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_inspiration.desc: Every 3s. If an undead is within 10 blocks, grants you hidden Darkness I for 2.5s.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_ritual_knowledge.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_true_perception.des: No mana cost, 30 second cooldown. Shows only the activation notice and has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_distortion_resist.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_secret_whisper.desc: Every 5 minutes, 30% chance to gain Strength I for 30 seconds.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_spirit_hearing.desc: Every 5s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 6s to creatures within 20 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_madness_power.desc: Costs no mana, cooldown 60s. Sanity -10. Randomly grants Strength II or Speed II for 30s; otherwise refunds 20 mana.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_inspiration_enhance: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_shadow_merge.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Grants yourself Invisibility I, Speed I for 15s. requires brightness of 3 or less, otherwise mana is refunded.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_shadow_summon.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 90s. Summons 1 shadow creature beside you, health 20, attack 6, for 30s. 15% chance it turns hostile and attacks you. Friendly summons attack nearby enemies and despawn when the time ends.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_shadow_curse.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 45s. Up to 1 targets within 15 blocks along your look and applies Slowness II, Weakness I for 15s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_shadow_manipulate.d: Costs 5 mana, 10 second cooldown. Shoves the target within 10 blocks of your look in a random direction. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_shadow_shaping.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 20s. Up to 1 targets within 12 blocks along your look. Deals 5 magic damage and applies Wither I, Slowness V for 5s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_flesh_magic.desc: While below 30% health, spends 1 mana and heals 2 each second.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_flesh_merge.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 1 min. Grants yourself Speed II, Invisibility I, Resistance II for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_flesh_bomb.desc: Costs 10 mana, 25 second cooldown. Spends 2 of your health, deals 10 magic damage to the target within 15 blocks of your look, and applies Poison II for 3 seconds. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_flesh_curse.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 2 min. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Wither I for 10 min. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.hm_flesh_servant.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 3 min. Consumes 5 rotten flesh and summons 1 zombie with 30 health and 8 attack for 2 min. Refunds mana if the items are missing.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_emotion_sense.desc: Every 3s. Hostile creatures within 10 blocks show anger particles, allies show hearts, and others show droplets. No status effect is applied.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_low_presence.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 45s. Grants yourself Invisibility I for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_micro_observe.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_memory_enhance.des: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_mind_read.desc: Costs 10 mana, 30 second cooldown. Reports in chat whether the target within 8 blocks of your look is locked onto an attack target. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_emotion_control.de: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 45s. Makes a creature within 8 blocks along your look attack the nearest other creature within 10 blocks, and applies Nausea I for 15s. Refunds mana if there is no valid target.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_lie_detect.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_mind_barrier.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_therapy.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. Clears common negative effects from a target within 8 blocks along your look, or from yourself if there is none. If the target is a player, sanity +20.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_hypnotic_hint.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 2 min. Up to 1 targets within 5 blocks along your look and applies Slowness III, Weakness II for 1 min. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_psycho_analysis.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_pacify.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 90s. Clears the attack target of creatures within 8 blocks and applies Weakness I for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_deep_hypnosis.desc: Costs 25 mana, cooldown 3 min. Up to 1 targets within 8 blocks along your look and applies Slowness II, Weakness II for 30 min. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_group_hint.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 2 min. Affects nearby creatures within 10 blocks, applies Slowness IV for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_dream_weave.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 1 min. Affects nearby creatures within 6 blocks, applies Nausea I, Darkness I for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_memory_edit.desc: Costs 20 mana, 3 minute cooldown. Clears the attack target and grudge of the mob within 8 blocks of your look. Refunds mana if there is no mob.
ability.guimi_mod.vis_mind_dominate.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_swim_mastery.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Dolphin's Grace I, Water Breathing I.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_strength_boost.des: Every 2s, refreshes hidden Strength for 5s: Strength II in water, otherwise Strength I.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_phantom_scales.des: When hit by a direct non-fire attack, 20% chance to halve that damage.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_balance.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_rage.desc: Taking damage adds one rage stack, up to 10. Each stack increases your damage by 3%. Stacks clear after 30s out of combat.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_rage_strike.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. applies Slowness IV, Nausea I for 3s; up to 1 targets within 4 blocks along look.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_constitution.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Health Boost II, Regeneration I.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_storm_resist.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_navigation.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_ocean_affinity.des: While in water, every 2s refreshes hidden Strength I, Speed I, and Resistance I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_water_control.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 8s. Grants Water Breathing I for 30s to allies within 5 blocks. If a target is within 15 blocks along your look, deals 4 magic damage and knocks it back.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_wind_blessing.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 30s. Affects other players and tamed creatures within 8 blocks, and yourself, applies Speed II for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_wind_blade.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 4s. Up to 2 targets within 20 blocks along your look. Deals 5 magic damage. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_wind_wings.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 1 min. Grants yourself Slow Falling I, Jump Boost III for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.tyr_hurricane_guard.de: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 30s. Knocks back hostile creatures within 3 blocks and grants you Resistance I for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_courage_song.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Affects other players and tamed creatures within 8 blocks, and yourself, applies Resistance I for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_purify_sound.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 10s. Affects undead within 6 blocks. Deals 4 magic damage, and knocks them back.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_constitution.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Health Boost I.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_pious_aura.desc: Every 5s. Refunds 1 mana to other players within 2 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_daylight.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Grants yourself Night Vision I, Glowing I for 1 min.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_blessing.desc: Costs 10 mana, 20 second cooldown. Applies Fire Resistance I and Strength I for 30 seconds to the target within 10 blocks of your look, or to yourself if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_sunshine.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 30s. Affects undead within 8 blocks. Deals 8 magic damage, applies Blindness I, Glowing I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_holy_water.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_holy_light.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 18s. Deals 6 magic damage to hostile creatures within 3 blocks, or 12 to undead.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_light_fire.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 25s. Deals 8 magic damage to undead within 6 blocks and ignites them for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.sun_purify_slash.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 15s. Grants yourself Strength II for 20s.

ability.guimi_mod.moon_life_drain.desc: Costs 10 mana, 25 second cooldown. Deals 10 magic damage to the target within 5 blocks of your look and heals you for the health it actually lost. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_vampire_fangs.des: After a direct melee hit, heal for 15% of the damage actually dealt.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_night_power.desc: Damage dealt is +20% at night and -15% during the day.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_bat_form.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. Grants Resistance V, Slow Falling, Jump Boost IV, Invisibility, and Bat Form for 15s, and summons 6 bats with 6 health and 2 attack for 1 min.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_blood_lure.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Pulls non-player creatures within 8 blocks toward you. Hostile ones also take 2 magic damage. Refunds mana if none are found.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_abyss_shackle.des: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 15s. Up to 1 targets within 8 blocks along your look and applies Slowness VIII for 10s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_dark_wings.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 40s. Grants Speed III and Slow Falling for 15s, and deals 5 magic damage to hostile creatures within 5 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_corrosion_claw.de: Direct melee hits deal 2 extra damage.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_blood_servant.des: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. Turns a non-player creature within 6 blocks along your look into a blood servant for 1 min. It follows you and attacks your target. Refunds mana for players or if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_potion_mastery.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_blood_potion.desc: No mana cost, 15 second cooldown. Spends 4 of your health to heal the target within 8 blocks of your look for 6, or yourself if there is no target. Fails if your health is 4 or less.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_toxin_master.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_mutation_potion.d: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 90s. applies Nausea I, Poison I, Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II, Fire Resistance I, Jump Boost III, Invisibility I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_harvest_hand.desc: Every 5s. Applies bone meal to up to 4 spots within 4 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_nature_affinity.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_diagnose.desc: Costs 1 mana, cooldown 3s. Reports the name, health, and max health of a target within 10 blocks along your look. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_first_aid.desc: Costs 10 mana, 40 second cooldown. Heals the target within 8 blocks of your look for 8 and clears common negative effects, or yourself if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_disease_resist.des: Every 3s. Removes Poison, Wither, and Hunger from you.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_harvest_blessing.d: Costs 25 mana, cooldown 2 min. Bone-meals up to 60 crops within 15 blocks, and grants you and allies Regeneration II and Saturation for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_thorns.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 25s. Affects hostile creatures within 5 blocks. Deals 2 magic damage, applies Slowness III, Poison I for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_nature_heal.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 45s. Clears common negative effects from you and allies within 10 blocks, and heals each for 10.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_earth_power.desc: While standing on grass, dirt, coarse dirt, podzol, or farmland, every 2s refreshes hidden Strength II and Resistance II for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_bio_modify.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 5 min. Raises max health and attack by 30% on a tamed, not-yet-modified animal within 8 blocks along your look, and fills its health. Each animal can be modified once. Refunds mana if it does not qualify.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_nature_wrath.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 1 min. Affects hostile creatures within 15 blocks. Deals 8 magic damage, applies Slowness V for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_life_share.desc: Costs 20 mana, 3 minute cooldown. Averages your current health with another player within 10 blocks of your look, capped at each maximum. Refunds mana if the target is not a player.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_plague_aura.desc: Every 3s. Removes Poison and Wither from you and from allies within 8 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.err_steal.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 20s. Takes the main-hand item of a creature within 5 blocks along your look. Refunds mana if that hand is empty or there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_agile_hands.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Haste I, Speed I.
ability.guimi_mod.err_keen_observation.d: Every 5s. Makes dropped items within 10 blocks glow.
ability.guimi_mod.err_short_blade.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_constitution.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Health Boost I, Speed I.
ability.guimi_mod.err_micro_expression.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_charisma.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_eloquence.desc: Costs 5 mana, 30 second cooldown. Makes the mob within 10 blocks of your look drop its attack target. Refunds mana if there is no mob.
ability.guimi_mod.err_mislead.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 45s. Makes a creature within 10 blocks along your look attack the nearest other creature within 10 blocks. Refunds mana if there is no valid target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_mind_disturb.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 25s. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Nausea I for 10s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_agility.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Speed I.
ability.guimi_mod.err_clue_analysis.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 30s. Applies Glowing I for 10s to creatures within 10 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.err_dream_analysis.des: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_puzzle_deduce.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_spirit_intuition.d: Every 3s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 4s to invisible creatures within 15 blocks, or to creatures there that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.err_trace_reading.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_ability_steal.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 3 min. Range 50 blocks along your look. A normal cast steals an item from the target; sneaking plants a dangerous item in its main hand and takes the old one. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_telekinesis.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Pulls dropped items within 50 blocks toward you. Refunds mana if there are none.
ability.guimi_mod.err_treasure_sense.des: Every 10s. Makes dropped items within 50 blocks glow.
ability.guimi_mod.err_body_boost.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Strength I, Speed I, Health Boost II.
ability.guimi_mod.err_pollution_resist.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_open_door.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Passes through a wall in front of you up to about 3 blocks thick if the far side is standable. Refunds mana if there is no wall or it is too thick.
ability.guimi_mod.door_ritual.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_space_intuition.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_escape_instinct.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_flash.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 12s. Affects hostile creatures within 5 blocks, applies Blindness I, Glowing I for 3s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_black_curtain.des: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. Affects nearby creatures within 3 blocks, applies Darkness I for 8s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_gas_transfer.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Removes Poison from you and allies within 15 blocks, then applies Poison I for 10s to one hostile creature within 15 blocks. Refunds mana if nobody was poisoned.
ability.guimi_mod.door_loud_bang.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. Affects nearby creatures within 10 blocks, applies Nausea I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_freeze.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 12s. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Slowness III for 5s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_shock.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 8s. Up to 1 targets within 3 blocks along your look. Deals 3 magic damage and applies Slowness VI for 2s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_fog.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 25s. Applies Darkness I for 20s to creatures within 15 blocks and releases smoke particles around you.
ability.guimi_mod.door_wind.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 10s. Affects nearby creatures within 8 blocks, and knocks them back.
ability.guimi_mod.door_ignite.desc: Costs 3 mana, 3 second cooldown. Sets the target within 3 blocks of your look on fire for 5 seconds. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_trip.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Slowness V for 3s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_trip_area.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 20s. Affects nearby creatures within 6 blocks, applies Slowness IV for 6s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_move_object.desc: Costs 3 mana, cooldown 5s. Throws dropped items within 5 blocks along your look. Refunds mana if there are none.
ability.guimi_mod.door_escape_trick.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 20s. Blinks along your look, up to 5 blocks, onto a standable spot.
Every 3s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 4s to creatures within 16 blocks that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.door_astrology.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 45s. applies Luck I for 1 min.
ability.guimi_mod.door_anti_divination.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_star_knowledge.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_record.desc: Costs 5 mana, 10 second cooldown. Records the name of the target within 20 blocks of your look for Record Release. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_record_release.de: Costs 15 mana, 30 second cooldown. Requires a recorded target. Consumes the record, then deals 3 magic damage to the target within 15 blocks of your look. Refunds mana if there is no record.
ability.guimi_mod.door_record_manage.des: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_spirit_boost.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.be_distortion.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 20s. Enters distortion mode for 15s; cast again to exit. While in mode: invert movement for 5s, redirect attacks for 5s, deflect projectiles for 3s, seal around a door, isolate a room, and hijack a player's divination for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_distortion.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 20s. Enters distortion mode for 15s; cast again to exit. Allows movement inversion for 5s, projectile deflection for 3s, a door seal, and room isolation. Attack redirect and divination hijack are denied.
ability.guimi_mod.whl_distortion.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 20s. Enters distortion mode for 15s; cast again to exit. Allows attack redirect for 5s, projectile deflection for 3s, and divination hijack on a player for 30s. Movement inversion, door seals, and room isolation are denied.
ability.guimi_mod.seer_divination.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Makes monsters within 16 blocks glow for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.fighting_mastery.desc: Every 2s, refreshes Strength I and Speed I for 4.5s. Fall damage is reduced to 20%.
ability.guimi_mod.flying_card.desc: Costs 1 mana, cooldown 0.5s. Consumes paper and throws a card. In scatter mode it throws 5 cards at sequence 6 or lower, otherwise 3. It does not cast without paper.
ability.guimi_mod.damage_transfer.desc: Fake health absorbs damage first and drops by 1 per second. At 0 fake health, a fatal hit is cancelled, health becomes 1, and you gain 30 fake health.
ability.guimi_mod.water_breathing.desc: While underwater, refreshes Water Breathing every 2s for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.bone_softening.desc: In a cobweb or powder snow, horizontal speed is tripled and vertical speed is 1.5 times. Sneaking into a low gap makes you crawl; crawling slows you and blocks item use.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_jump.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Teleports to fire or a lit campfire within 2 blocks of a block you look at, up to 30 blocks away. Does not teleport if no fire is found.
ability.guimi_mod.air_bullet.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 2s. Fires an air bullet that deals 5 damage.
ability.guimi_mod.paper_substitute.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 30s. Teleports to the nearest paper figurine within 10 blocks and consumes it. Fails with no figurine or while abyss-corrupted.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_control.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 3s. Ignites a target within 30 blocks along your look for 6s and deals 2 fire damage. With no target, lights a fire at the crosshair.
ability.guimi_mod.illusion.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Places an illusion up to 30 blocks along your look. Creatures within 16 blocks drop their target and move there.
ability.guimi_mod.disguise.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 15s. Makes creatures within 32 blocks that are targeting you drop that target.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_jump_advanced.de: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Teleports to fire or a lit campfire within 2 blocks of a block you look at, up to 45 blocks away. Does not teleport if no fire is found.
ability.guimi_mod.air_bullet_advanced.de: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 2s. Fires an air bullet that deals 8 damage.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_control_advanced: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 3s. Ignites a target within 30 blocks along your look for 6s and deals 2.6 fire damage. With no target, lights a fire at the crosshair.
ability.guimi_mod.paper_substitute_advan: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 7.5s. Teleports to the nearest paper figurine within 10 blocks and consumes it. Fails with no figurine or while abyss-corrupted.
ability.guimi_mod.spirit_thread_vision.d: Costs 2 mana, cooldown 1s. Only sequence 9 can toggle spirit vision. While on, grants Night Vision for 15s and makes creatures within 30 blocks glow.
Costs 15 mana, cooldown 30s. Controls a creature within 20 blocks for 5s, applying Slowness III, Mining Fatigue III, and Glowing.
ability.guimi_mod.marionette_combat.desc: Costs 3 mana, cooldown 2s. Orders your marionette to attack a target within 24 blocks along your look. It cannot be used without a marionette.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_mastery.desc: Once unlocked, flame control lights a 3×3 area when it has no target. It does not apply a continuous effect by itself.
ability.guimi_mod.shared_vision.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 1s. Toggles marionette control.
ability.guimi_mod.light_footsteps.desc: Keeps Jump Boost I and Slow Falling refreshed. Sprinting grants +10% speed. Fall damage is cancelled.
ability.guimi_mod.eagle_eye.desc: Keeps Night Vision refreshed. Every 2s, makes creatures 12 to 32 blocks away glow.
ability.guimi_mod.shadow_hiding.desc: While the block you stand in has brightness 4 or less, refreshes Invisibility every 0.5s for 1.5s.
ability.guimi_mod.weakpoint_strike.desc: A sneak attack from behind the target deals double damage. Internal cooldown 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.constitution_boost.des: Max health +4, and Resistance I is kept refreshed.
ability.guimi_mod.charm.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. On a creature within 10 blocks: hostile ones are calmed for 30s, others follow you for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.misdirect.desc: Cast in two steps, range 15 blocks. First pick a source creature, then a new target, and rewrite its attack for 15s. The class also counts 10 mana and a 45s cooldown.
ability.guimi_mod.persuade.desc: Interacting with a villager grants Hero of the Village II for 10s. If the villager has fewer than 12 offers, there is a 15% chance to add a trade of 6 soyle for 3 experience bottles.
ability.guimi_mod.gender_transition.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.witch_invisibility.des: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 90s. Starts invisibility, with a 2s transition, lasting 30s. Attacking or taking damage interrupts it.
ability.guimi_mod.black_flame.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Fires 1 black flame that deals 6 damage.
ability.guimi_mod.frost_control.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 10s. Freezes a target within 8 blocks for 3s and applies slowness. With no creature, it acts on the looked-at block.
ability.guimi_mod.mirror_divination.desc: Triggered by the mirror item. Costs 10 mana, cooldown 20s. The mirror will not start divination without this ability.
ability.guimi_mod.mirror_substitute.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 120s. Teleports to the saved mirror anchor. Fails with no anchor or while abyss-corrupted. Without mastery, the anchor is cleared. A fatal hit also tries to trigger it.
ability.guimi_mod.wand_substitute.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 120s. Teleports to the player holding the wand bound to you. Fails while abyss-corrupted. A fatal hit also tries to trigger it.
ability.guimi_mod.charm_aura.desc: Every 3s. An uncharmed creature within 10 blocks has a 15% chance to be calmed for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.mirror_mastery.desc: After mirror substitute teleports, there is a 50% chance to keep the anchor. Without this, the anchor is always cleared.
ability.guimi_mod.spider_silk.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 15s. Applies Slowness IV and Mining Fatigue for 8s to a target within 20 blocks. Sneaking instead pulls you toward the target.
ability.guimi_mod.cocoon.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 120s. Enters a cocoon for 5s. Non-fire damage is cancelled; fire damage breaks the cocoon and is doubled.
ability.guimi_mod.black_flame_advanced.d: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Fires 7 black flames, 8 damage each. Sneaking instead clears all of your negative effects and does not fire.
ability.guimi_mod.ice_spear.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 10s. Throws an ice spear forward.
ability.guimi_mod.frost_armor.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 90s. Activates frost armor for 20s. Damage taken is reduced by 30% during that time.
ability.guimi_mod.curse.desc: Costs 50 mana, cooldown 120s. Requires a mirror in hand. Applies Blindness, Slowness, Weakness, or Poison at random to a target within 15 blocks for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.body_enhancement.desc: Max health +4, and Strength I and Speed I are kept refreshed.
ability.guimi_mod.trace_tracking.desc: Records nearby creature tracks every second. Sneak-right-click the ground with an empty hand to reveal them.
ability.guimi_mod.weakness_insight.desc: Sneaking observes and analyzes a target. Melee damage against an analyzed target is +30%.
ability.guimi_mod.wild_knowledge.desc: Sneak-right-click a block: paper plus 2 sweet berries makes a hemostatic salve; a glass bottle plus a spider eye makes basic poison.
ability.guimi_mod.danger_sense.desc: Every 0.5s, checks creatures within 8 blocks that are moving or targeting you. The base version only senses those behind you. Danger plays a heartbeat and sets the danger flag.
ability.guimi_mod.war_constitution.desc: Max health +2. While hunger is at least 18, heals 0.5 every 4s.
ability.guimi_mod.weakness_insight_advan: When analysis completes, also lists the target's sensitive traits in chat. The damage bonus still comes from weakness insight.
ability.guimi_mod.provoke.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 5 mana and has a 20s cooldown. Enrages a creature within 15 blocks. A known type lasts 20s, otherwise 5s. Enraged attacks can miss.
ability.guimi_mod.pyro_fire_resistance.d: Clears fire immediately if you are burning. Fire damage taken is reduced by 80%. Explosion damage is not reduced.
While spirit vision is on, every 0.5s marks nearby creatures' ether colors for you only.
Danger sense covers 360 degrees within 8 blocks. Every 5s it also notes stalkers farther away that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_enchant.desc: A direct melee hit ignites a non-fire-immune target for 4s.
ability.guimi_mod.fireball.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The first cast starts charging; the next releases it. A red fireball costs 5 mana and has a 3s cooldown; the compressed white one costs 10 mana and has an 8s cooldown. A full charge is about 4s.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_armor.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Activates flame armor for 15s. Melee attackers take 2 thorns damage and burn for 2s. Freeze damage is halved.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_weapon.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 20s. Gives a flame weapon for 1 min. If flame shaping is unlocked, the weapon uses that branch.
ability.guimi_mod.delayed_blast.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. If you already have a flame trap within 30 blocks, it detonates that trap; otherwise it spends 8 mana and throws one.
ability.guimi_mod.fire_injection.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Arms for 3s. The next melee hit during that window injects a delayed blast into the target.
ability.guimi_mod.fire_raven.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 8 mana and has a 12s cooldown. Sends 5 fire ravens at a target within 15 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.white_flame_spear.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 15s. Throws a white flame spear forward.
ability.guimi_mod.burning_wall.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 10 mana and has a 25s cooldown. Places a fire wall for 8s up to 20 blocks along your look.
ability.guimi_mod.giant_fireball.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. Start charging, then cast again to release. Costs 20 mana, cooldown 60s. Charge time is 15 to 20s, halved if white compression is unlocked.
ability.guimi_mod.intellect_boost.desc: Keeps Hero of the Village I refreshed. Interacting with a villager upgrades it to Hero of the Village III for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_shaping.desc: Unlocks the shaping branch of the flame weapon. It does not apply a continuous effect by itself.
ability.guimi_mod.white_compression.desc: Unlocks the compressed branch of fireball charging and the giant fireball. It does not apply a continuous effect by itself.
ability.guimi_mod.fire_body.desc: On a direct physical hit that is not fire or an explosion, if ready, become fire for 3s and cancel that hit. Cooldown 90s. In that form those physical hits are cancelled, and freeze damage is doubled.
ability.guimi_mod.intel_network.desc: Interacting with a villager has a 30% chance to report another employed player within 64 blocks, rounded to about 10 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.mislead.desc: Cast in two steps, range 20 blocks. First pick a source, then rewrite its attack for 30s. The class also counts 10 mana and a 45s cooldown.
ability.guimi_mod.incite.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 12 mana and has a 60s cooldown. Makes non-hostile creatures within 10 blocks attack a target within 20 blocks along your look for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_leap.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 8 mana and has an 8s cooldown. Leaps to your own fireball, flame trap, or fire wall within 30 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.characteristic_herding: Every second, slowly pulls same-pathway or neighboring-pathway characteristic items within 8 times the configured attraction range toward you.
sequence.guimi_mod.fool.9.intro: Seer. This rank grants 1 active and 1 passive skills, including Pendulum Intuition, Crisis Divination. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.guimi_mod.fool.8.intro: Clown. This rank grants 1 active and 1 passive skills, including Fighting Mastery, Flying Card. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.

sequence.guimi_mod.fool.5.intro: Marionettist. This rank grants 4 active and 1 passive skills, including Spirit Thread Vision, Spirit Thread Control, Marionette Combat, Flame Mastery, Shared Vision. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.guimi_mod.fool.4.intro: Bizarro Sorcerer. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.guimi_mod.fool.3.intro: Scholar of Antiquity. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.

sequence.guimi_mod.fool.0.intro: The Fool. This rank grants 0 active and 2 passive skills, including Characteristic Herding, Characteristic Herding. Sequence 2 and above also receive characteristic herding.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.9.intro: Thief. This rank grants 1 active and 4 passive skills, including Pilfer, Nimble Hands, Superb Observation, Short Blade Mastery, Constitution Boost. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.8.intro: Swindler. This rank grants 3 active and 3 passive skills, including Micro-Expression Reading, Charisma, Eloquence, Misdirection, Mental Interference, Agility Boost. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.7.intro: Cryptologist. This rank grants 1 active and 4 passive skills, including Clue Analysis, Dream Analysis, Puzzle Deduction, Spiritual Intuition, Trail Reading. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.6.intro: Fire Stealer. This rank grants 2 active and 3 passive skills, including Ability Theft, Telekinetic Theft, Treasure Sense, Constitution Boost, Pollution Resistance. Range, damage, and cooldown are on each skill.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.5.intro: Dream Stealer. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.4.intro: Parasite. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.
sequence.guimi_mod.error.3.intro: Mentor of Deceit. This rank grants no extra skills. Abilities already gained from earlier sequences remain.

item.lotm.cultist_echo.desc: A diary dated July 7, Sunday, clear. Right-click to read.
item.lotm.cultist_echo.pages:
July 7, Sunday, Clear

Today is the day of the Lord's descent. With reverence and gratitude I came early to the sanctuary for this solemn communion.

As the opening hymn echoed under the dome, the congregation sang as one, and praise rose like a fragrant offering. The pastor stepped to the pulpit and led the prayer of confession and cleansing: "Merciful Father, nothing can be hidden before You... blot out our trespasses with Your abundant mercy." In the silence I seemed to feel a spring wash the hidden evil and worldly dust from my heart, so I could stand clean in the sanctuary.

The heart of the rite was the consecration. The pastor lifted blood and bone in both hands and read the institution in a grave voice: "Lord, You are the myriad and the one. Your formless body dwells among the stars. We suffer under the evil god, bearing the ugly name of Actors. Hear our reply. We offer You what the evil god values most. Descend." When the knife that stood for salvation was placed in my hand, I closed my eyes and drove it into my own chest. In that moment the gaze of the stars seemed truly to fall underground and touch my soul. We had become part of Him......
